course_outcomes.text: Illustrate the concept of systems software
Illustrate the concept of process scheduling algorithms to solve scheduling problems
Explain the concepts of deadlock and illustrate the techniques to detect, prevent and avoid the deadlock
Demonstrate the use of page replacement algorithms for memory management
Explain the concept of I/O management techniques
Demonstrate the use of Linux commands and basic shell utilities
